stories.headline: FOMC decides Wednesday under new Chair Kevin Warsh; rate-hike odds risen to ~35-39%
stories.one_line: Non-SEP meeting; Kevin Warsh (Fed Chair since May 22, 2026) leads his first FOMC decision Wed 2:00 PM ET; press-reported CME FedWatch odds moved from ~80-90% hold to ~61-65% hold / 35-39% hike this month before this weekend's oil reversal.
stories.score_note: Highest-importance scheduled event of the week; drives rates and equities broadly; chair-identity correction elevates verification priority.

stories.headline: Microsoft, Meta, Arm, Qualcomm report Wed; Visa, Apple, Amazon report Thu into AI-capex scrutiny
stories.one_line: Four hyperscalers on pace for ~$725B combined 2026 AI capex; Meta guides $125-145B FY26 capex, Microsoft FY27 capex modeled near $262B by analysts; forecast 2026-07-26-sun-3 (>=1 name moves >5% on capex commentary) remains open.
stories.score_note: Concentrated index-level risk given combined mega-cap weight; lands same week as FOMC.

stories.headline: US-Iran pause holds a third day; oil craters ~5-7%, US futures surge into FOMC week
stories.one_line: Ceasefire (Apr 8, extended Apr 21) broke down ~Jul 8-13 with resumed strikes; new pause began Jul 23-24, now three consecutive quiet nights per Bloomberg/CNBC/CNN (Jul 27). WTI fell ~5.4% to $84.51; US equity futures jumped 0.8-1.4% (secondary-sourced, Yahoo API rate-limited this run). Durability vs April's pattern (pause then breakdown) remains the key unknown.
stories.score_note: High-risk/war-adjacent story with direct market impact this run; two-source rule applied.

stories.headline: Ukraine confirms Caspian Sea strike on Iran-linked vessel; Iran vows retaliation, disputes cargo characterization
stories.one_line: Upgraded from single-source: Ukraine's own government (Zelensky, SBU) now confirms the Jul 25 strike, describing military cargo (drone/missile components) moving Iran-Russia. Iran disputes this, says the vessel was civilian, one sailor killed; FM Araghchi says the strike 'cannot go unanswered.' Cargo manifest and casualty account remain disputed between the two sides.
stories.score_note: Escalation risk for the broader Iran conflict, now entangled with Russia-Ukraine; watch for Iranian retaliation.

stories.headline: Q2 2026 GDP advance estimate, Thu Jul 30 8:30 ET
stories.one_line: GDPNow tracking estimate +1.7% as of Jul 17 (down from a late-May peak near 3.8%); today's Jul 27 GDPNow update lands after this report's news cutoff. Forecast refined to 1.0-2.5% (2026-07-27-am-2), superseding Sunday's wider band.
stories.score_note: Critical scheduled macro release, one day after FOMC.

stories.headline: Employment Cost Index Q2 2026, Fri Jul 31 8:30 ET
stories.one_line: Fed's preferred wage-inflation gauge, closes out the week's data calendar.

stories.headline: SpaceX Starship Flight 13 mostly successful — first flight since IPO
stories.one_line: Jul 24 flight: all 33 first-stage engines nominal, 20 Starlink V3 sats deployed, intact heatshield through splashdown. Backdrop/context item, no fresh development this run.
stories.score_note: Backdrop/context item, not this-week catalyst; kept on watchlist for continued public-company technical track record.

stories.headline: Active ransomware/extortion campaigns: Cl0p/Windchill, OAuth-Klue, ClickFix/Steam, ShinyHunters sextortion follow-on
stories.one_line: Cl0p targeting PTC Windchill/FlexPLM for extortion (Jul 25); new OAuth-grant abuse (Klue breach) and ClickFix-via-Steam cryptominer campaigns reported this week. No new watchlist-company 8-K cyber-incident filings found in this run's 90-company EDGAR sweep.
stories.score_note: Background single-name risk across the watchlist.

stories.headline: OpenAI reportedly weighing IPO delay to 2027; Anthropic pushing toward an October 2026 debut
stories.one_line: Reverses Sunday's framing (OpenAI 'possible Sept 2026' listing). Press-reported only for both; neither has a public EDGAR filing. Registry updated this run.
stories.score_note: Registry-relevant; private-module entity status watch; reversal of listing-order expectation.

stories.headline: Wildfires force 300,000+ evacuations across Spain and France amid European heatwave
stories.one_line: 320,000+ evacuated across France/Spain; Gironde fire (~100k acres) approached Bordeaux, Macron called a Monday crisis meeting; 14 confirmed dead in Spain, 10 missing; Madrid-area fire beyond firefighting capacity at peak. Italy, Portugal, UK also affected; no rain forecast this week. No direct US market linkage identified.
stories.score_note: Large-scale humanitarian/disaster story; new this run given scale.

stories.headline: Bipartisan FRONTIER Act introduced in House to regulate catastrophic-risk AI models
stories.one_line: Obernolte (R-CA)/Trahan (D-MA) bill defines catastrophic risk as >50 deaths or >$1B property damage; tiered developer requirements plus 3-year state-law preemption theme carried from June discussion draft. No committee action yet.
stories.score_note: First bipartisan House frontier-AI safety bill of this scope this session; intersects with mega-cap AI-capex earnings week.

stories.headline: NDAA FY2027: House passed 216-212, stalled in Senate
stories.one_line: H.R. 8800 ($1.15T) passed House; Senate companion S. 4784 reported by Armed Services Committee (18-9, Jun 15) but stalled after a Jun 24 cloture filing; Senate briefly took up and withdrew a motion to proceed Jul 27.
stories.score_note: Direct relevance to defense/aerospace watchlist via program authorizations.
